label: preparing
what: A coordinated hospitality gathering in the great hall at eighteen hundred, with a large reserve of fresh bread and arrangements kept from me until then. Innkeeper, builder and freight form the hospitality committee; baker and neighbour appear involved in provisioning or coordination. Secretary knowingly helps reserve the appointment and keep me from arriving early, but may not know its actual purpose. The precise occasion is unconfirmed; bridge/port-change rumours are not reliable confirmation of its purpose.
